## Product identity

IZEM AI Fitness Coach is a consumer fitness application for iOS and Android. The app/package identifier is `com.ai.gym.coach`. IZEM is an independently developed early-stage product and is not affiliated with the B2B consulting website at `youraicoach.ai` or with other businesses that use the name IZEM.

## Current first-party scope

IZEM is designed to provide:

- weekly workout planning based on goals, schedule, equipment, level, recovery, and progress;
- practical weekly meal planning based on preferences, budget, schedule, lifestyle, and general macro targets;
- optional food, body-progress, and gym-equipment scans for coaching context;
- workout and meal check-ins;
- day reviews and weekly plan adaptation;
- coach memory for useful preferences, prior decisions, and recurring constraints;
- optional proactive voice calls for workout reminders, accountability, and reviews;
- exercise substitutions and progressive-overload support.

Feature availability can change while the product is developed. The canonical product page is the current public source of truth.

## Safety and limitations

IZEM provides general fitness and nutrition guidance. It does not diagnose injuries or medical conditions, provide medical treatment, replace injury rehabilitation, or provide hands-on exercise-form correction. Scan outputs are context for coaching and should not be described as clinical measurements. Users should seek qualified professional guidance for pain, injury, medical conditions, eating disorders, pregnancy-related needs, or technical lifting instruction.

This file does not publish competitor prices, rankings, or yes/no feature claims.
